assumptions: All four tiers are served by the existing Vermilion House1 receptionist to avoid new physical content.
Trial Single remains the default first menu entry and retains the existing three-battle tutorial path.
NPC Partner Multi is local AI cooperation; link communication is never a prerequisite.
Ultimate gimmick and Full UBER preset are chosen before snapshot confirmation so cancel has no save mutation.
A player may preserve a completed-round streak by safe retirement; re-entry starts a fresh rental run at battle one.

pending_run_flow.behavior: active run is forfeited; exact original party is restored; active current streak resets
pending_run_flow.detection: snapshot_valid true or masked marker not OUTSIDE
pending_run_flow.priority: before all menus and before player movement
pending_run_flow.result_pending_behavior: only already-persisted streak increments remain; no duplicate result or reward is applied
pending_run_flow.save_failure_behavior: show DIALOGUE_SAVE_FAILED and remain in recovery loop with controls blocked

unlock_flow.policy: locked tiers remain visible with no entry side effects; unlocked mode list is deterministic
unlock_flow.unlock_refresh: read current save flags on every receptionist interaction

assumptions: Existing mode manifest row order is the compatibility order for slots 0..15; new modes occupy 16..23.
The existing reward_pending byte is packed without changing layout; Trial slot 0 retains its historical numeric values.
The marker byte is masked by new accessors; high bits are session options and low three bits remain VegaFactoryMarker.
Active runs are not resumed after reset because exact restore and anti-reroll safety take priority.
A safe retire is offered only after the round reward has committed; it preserves current streak but ends the run.
The 100 milestone is a per-battle trigger inside a continuing seven-battle round; max_milestone 98 denotes the last complete-round checkpoint.

battle_result_contract.best_streak: monotonic and never reset by loss or forfeit
battle_result_contract.exactly_once: transaction_id plus persistent marker makes every result and reward idempotent

master_milestones.100: after committed battle 100 even though it is inside the 99..105 round

battle_result_contract.swap: at most one opponent rental after each committed win; mode legality and clauses are rechecked before persistence
win_commit_order: persist updated streak and battle index

gimmick_contract.full: none or one Mega/Z per battle; Little none; Camomons optional Z
gimmick_contract.full_unrestricted_uber: bit 6 selects UBER preset; mode streak slot remains 20 for both presets
gimmick_contract.master: none or one Mega/Z/Tera per battle unless mode narrows the choice
gimmick_contract.standard: none or one Mega per battle according to selected set

ultimate.candidate_filter: only rental rows with matching ULTIMATE_GIMMICK tag
ultimate.duration: fixed until run exits and party is restored
ultimate.opponent_rule: opponent uses the same selected gimmick family and one activation per battle

party_snapshot_contract.capacity_policy: restore replaces the rental party and therefore cannot fail for party capacity
party_snapshot_contract.held_item_policy: original held items are restored byte-exactly; rental items never enter inventory
party_snapshot_contract.rental_dex_policy: seen only; caught and acquisition ledgers never change
party_snapshot_contract.snapshot_scope: party_count plus six complete 100-byte party records

save_resume_contract.persist_failure: remain in RECOVERY_BLOCKED and retry save; rental party is never released as owned party
save_resume_contract.recovery_priority: recovery executes before receptionist menu or map movement
save_resume_contract.reset_anti_reroll: any reset while snapshot_valid forfeits the active streak and discards generated rentals
save_resume_contract.safe_outside_policy: current streak remains and next entry begins a fresh run at battle one
save_resume_contract.uber_option: preset flag is cleared only after exact restore
save_resume_contract.ultimate_option: gimmick flag is cleared only after exact restore

marker.compatibility: Trial and non-option modes keep all high bits zero

reward_pending.compatibility: slot 0 values remain identical to the existing Trial counter
